title: RFC 7946: The GeoJSON Format
claims: GeoJSON defines JSON-based geospatial objects including LineString coordinates.
GeoJSON coordinates use longitude, latitude order and positions may include elevation.

verification.note: RFC 7946 正文可读：Section 3.1.1 规定 position 为经度、纬度顺序且可含第三个高程元素，Section 3.1.4 定义 LineString。
